senses.sense_definition: To remove cargo or goods from a vehicle, ship, or aircraft; unload.

examples.text: The workers began to <w>offload</w> the cargo containers as soon as the ship arrived at the port.
The delivery driver will <w>offload</w> the boxes at the warehouse before noon.

senses.sense_definition: To get rid of unwanted possessions, responsibilities, or problems by passing them to someone else.

examples.text: She tried to <w>offload</w> some of her extra work onto her junior colleagues.
The company decided to <w>offload</w> its unprofitable assets to cut costs.

senses.sense_definition: In sports such as rugby, to pass the ball to a teammate while being tackled.

examples.text: Even while being dragged to the ground, he managed to <w>offload</w> the ball to a teammate.
The player looked for an opportunity to <w>offload</w> before the defenders closed in.

senses.sense_definition: To remove a passenger from a flight, typically due to overbooking, weight restrictions, or standby status.

examples.text: The airline had to <w>offload</w> several standby passengers because the flight was fully booked.
Due to strict weight restrictions, the ground crew decided to <w>offload</w> non-essential personnel.

senses.sense_definition: To change a passenger's ticketing status from checked in back to open, enabling changes to the reservation.

examples.text: The gate agent had to <w>offload</w> the customer before rebooking him on the following morning flight.
The system will automatically <w>offload</w> the passenger record if the connection is missed.

senses.sense_definition: The act of discharging cargo, data, or tasks to another place or system.

examples.text: The storage server allows the automatic <w>offload</w> of archived files to secondary disks.
The rapid <w>offload</w> of freight was delayed by a mechanical breakdown at the terminal.

senses.sense_definition: In sports such as rugby, the act of passing the ball to a teammate while in the grasp of a tackler.

examples.text: A brilliant <w>offload</w> in the final seconds allowed the winger to score the winning try.
The defender anticipated the attempted <w>offload</w> and intercepted the pass cleanly.
